original_wording: Repeated UMAP bypasses randomness and reveals true topology.
revised_wording: Repeated seeded embeddings are concatenated as an empirical stability strategy. This implementation offers no theorem that it eliminates stochasticity, estimates expected distance, recovers true topology, or performs formal consensus clustering.
reason_or_limitation: Base parameters and software/hardware still matter.

original_wording: DBCV is the default DIMPLE score.
revised_wording: DBCV can be computed as an optional diagnostic, but legacy_dimple ranks using normalized silhouette and cluster count and, only when enabled, a subtracted noise term. DBCV is not a legacy score component.
reason_or_limitation: Base config may compute DBCV without using it for ranking.

revised_wording: Silhouette is defined relative to a distance metric; Freeze 3 supplies the configured HDBSCAN metric to scikit-learn. Its suitability remains geometry dependent.
reason_or_limitation: Other internal indices also have assumptions.

revised_wording: UMAP coordinates are descriptive latent coordinates and are not biological loadings, effects, mechanisms, or causal axes.
reason_or_limitation: Coordinates can be correlated descriptively if explicitly requested.

revised_wording: Label -1 means unassigned under the fitted representation, metric, density assumptions, and parameters. It does not establish biological irrelevance or lack of pleiotropy.
reason_or_limitation: Noise status can change across parameterizations.

revised_wording: Pearson/Spearman original-space summaries are post-selection descriptive diagnostics conditional on the retained partition; they do not prove causation, mechanism, replication, or unbiased significance.
reason_or_limitation: Correlation also reflects shared technical and LD structure.

revised_wording: K-means is optimized for centroid-based partitions and can be poorly matched to irregular density structure, but it is not universally ineffective.
reason_or_limitation: Performance depends on representation and objective.

original_wording: PCA/ICA components are proven biological mechanisms.
revised_wording: Genomic PCA/ICA provide linear components that may improve representation and interpretation; component reproducibility or loadings do not by themselves establish biological mechanisms or a gold standard.
reason_or_limitation: Oblong et al. support reproducibility and interpretability, not automatic causality.

revised_wording: Dependency pinning improves traceability but does not guarantee bitwise identity across OS, architecture, hardware, BLAS/OpenMP, thread counts, or numerical libraries.

original_wording: Principal and independent genomic components was authored by Zhang/Yang/Zhao.
revised_wording: The paper is by Oblong et al. (2024), DOI 10.1111/gbb.12876. The Gemini collective Zhang/Yang/Zhao attribution is unsupported by the current reviewer record.
reason_or_limitation: Zhang et al. 2023 is a different pleiotropy paper.
